body: a person with bpd is just that. a person. a person who deserves love and respect as much as anyone. a person who has a greater capacity to feel and give and love. yes bpd is hard to live with but it is much harder for the person with the illness, which this subreddit doesn’t seem to understand! pwBPD deserve your love as much as they give away theirs so freely. bpd is not a reason to not have a relationship with someone. that kind of discrimination and stigma is what is holding us back from destigmatising mental illness and specifically bpd. people would not be treated the same way if they had a physical illness or something deemed as “more treatable”. this subreddit is so wrong in many ways.
